questions.stem: A 16-year-old boy has a 3-year history of type 1 diabetes and has an HbA1c of 66.1 mmol/mol (8.2%), requiring his mother to administer his insulin due to his poor eyesight, a consequence of optic atrophy. He also has sensorineural deafness and requires a hearing aid. His current medication includes basal-bolus insulin regime consisting of insulin aspart tds and insulin glargine together with desmopressin bd. He has an average self-monitored glucose profile of 7.6 mmol/L. Which of the following is the likely diagnosis?
